mentions.name: Necronomicon of delinking (planned guide)
mentions.description: A contemplated in-depth written guide (called the "Necronomicon of delinking") explaining the counterintuitive concepts behind delinking, which the author says require unlearning standard computer science fundamentals before they can be understood. It is envisioned as a complement to the Ghidra delinker extension, whose UX alone cannot convey these ideas.
mentions.problem: The delinking technique requires throwing away conventional CS fundamentals before it can be understood, and UX improvements to the extension alone cannot teach it.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm also thinking about writing the Necronomicon of delinking at some point. The extension keeps spreading by word of mouth and there's only so much UX improvements I can do, for something that requires throwing everything you've learned in CS 101 into the trashcan before you can "get" it.
